- Identifies conversion bottlenecks and prioritizes optimization actions.
- Provides a structured experiment roadmap tied to campaign goals (ROAS/CPA).
- Includes clear input/output contract and practical guided examples.
- Built-in decision rules, platform-specific guidance, and failure handling protocols.
